scenario: Connected, physical Codex auto; ordinary sidebar browsing, not editing; no voice or configuration action initiated by sampler
limits: Two-minute sample, not long-duration GIF, sleep, old-firmware or energy-impact acceptance
CPU ratio uses process CPU time divided by observed wall time; not lifetime ps percent
measurementNote: Initial discovery sampler rejected a process identity mismatch; no first-run values used. Final sampler pinned exact long-running App/Agent PIDs and executable paths, avoiding transient invocations of same Agent executable.
